rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for including things within a scope, including a complete range.

example.english: This course is designed to encompass grammar, conversation, and writing.

rows.note: Use this when something physically surrounds or encircles something else.

example.english: Tall buildings on all sides encompass the park.

rows.note: Use this when something physically encloses or contains something, especially by wrapping around it.

example.english: The walls encompass the whole garden.
example.traditional: 四邊嘅圍牆包住成個花園。
